title: rubus koehleri subsp. gerezianus
intro: Rubus koehleri subsp. gerezianus, commonly known as Gerez Raspberry, is a plant species within the rose family (Rosaceae) that is native to Morocco. This plant is valued for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Gerez Raspberry include anti-diarrheal, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Rubus koehleri subsp. gerezianus include ellagic acid, gallic acid, and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
